senses.definition: large slow-growing evergreen shrub or small tree with multiple stems; extensively used for hedges or borders and topiary figures
(of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves
examples: Hollywood seems full of curvaceous blondes
a curvy young woman in a tight dress

senses.definition: (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous
examples: a generation ago … buxom actresses were popular

senses.definition: the bodily property of being attractively plump and vigorous and (of women) full-bosomed
